svg.title: Pick a model: CT0 variants, size, browser support, time per decision and System-1 accuracy
svg.text: System-1 hits on the CT0 decision test set: 172 security questions with known answers (65 yes/no, 57 multiple choice, 50 severity 1–5). Color: vs the original model.
In the browser — Chrome WebGPU, Apple M2 Pro
within 2 answers of the original model
Reads: yes/no from the logits, multiple choice from the head, severity from head_score.bin (exact level); MLC: heads on the hidden state recovered from the logits.
Original model (PyTorch bf16, as released): 54/65 · 46/57 · 26/50. Time: median per question in Chrome (MLC: mean; genai: hot prefill).
† accuracy of the same int4 build on onnxruntime-genai CUDA; in Chrome its decisions match it on every question checked (12/12).
